title: Article 74 — Council of Ministers to aid and advise President

content.overview: Article 74 provides that there shall be a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advise the President, who shall, in the exercise of his functions, act in accordance with such advice. The President may require the Council of Ministers to reconsider such advice, and the President shall act in accordance with the advice tendered after such reconsideration. The question whether any, and if so what, advice was tendered by Ministers to the President shall not be inquired into in any court.
content.glance: Council of Ministers (PM at head) aids and advises President; President shall act in accordance with advice (after optional reconsideration). Advice not justiciable.
content.study:
Article 74 (as amended by the 42nd and 44th Amendments):
(1) There shall be a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advise the President who shall, in the exercise of his functions, act in accordance with such advice:
Provided that the President may require the Council of Ministers to reconsider such advice, either generally or otherwise, and the President shall act in accordance with the advice tendered after such reconsideration.
(2) The question whether any, and if so what, advice was tendered by Ministers to the President shall not be inquired into in any court.

This is the constitutional foundation of the parliamentary executive: the President is the formal head; the real executive is the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.

Examination: obligatory aid and advice; act in accordance with advice; one reconsideration; non-justiciability of advice content.

sections.heading: Core rules
sections.body:
1. Council of Ministers with PM at the head to aid and advise the President.
2. President shall act in accordance with such advice.
3. President may require reconsideration once; then must act in accordance with advice after reconsideration.
4. Advice content not open to court inquiry.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain Article 74.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 74 provides that there shall be a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advise the President, who shall act in accordance with such advice in the exercise of his functions. The President may require the Council to reconsider the advice, and shall then act in accordance with the advice tendered after reconsideration. Whether any, and if so what, advice was tendered is not to be inquired into in any court.

examTips: Aid and advice mandatory; one reconsideration; advice not justiciable.

keyTakeaways: Art 74: CoM aids and advises; President bound (after optional reconsideration); advice non-justiciable.
